scripts.lint: npm run build && npx --yes web-ext@10.8.0 lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build && npx --yes web-ext@10.8.0 run --source-dir dist/firefox --start-url https://github.com
scripts.package: npm run build && npx --yes web-ext@10.8.0 build --source-dir dist/chromium --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename cherry-pick-{version}-chromium.zip --overwrite-dest && npx --yes web-ext@10.8.0 build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename cherry-pick-{version}-firefox-unsigned.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build && npx --yes web-ext@10.8.0 sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel unlisted
